title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Ecological Stability
about: Postdoctoral research fellowship (100%, up to three years) in Prof. Owen Petchey's group at the University of Zurich for a researcher leading their own programme on ecological stability, e.g. response diversity, through theory, modelling, experiments or observational data. Start 1 January 2027 at the earliest.
requirements: PhD awarded no more than four years before the application deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "a researcher leading their own programme on ecological stability" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"through theory, modelling, experiments or observational data" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
